originalQuestionUnchanged.individualQuestion: Preserve transforming WILLING CREATURES INTO CHOSEN BEASTS; Core Action/120ft/Instantaneous. Define recipient count/selection,finite duration/concentration,actual approved beast profile/CR limits and who chooses each form. Retain multiple willing recipients rather than replacing the effect with one Polymorph. Bind each target's size,HP,abilities,senses,movement,actions,casting,gear/melded cargo,damage and return independently to reviewed form rules. No unknown bestiary profile is granted by a creature label; provide exact form evidence before adoption. Recasting/ending/suppression cannot duplicate bodies,restore resources or create new harvestable matter.

resolution: The complete proposed procedure, its explicit NEW choices and scoped source reuse answer this whole identity question. All printed benefits/native access retained; no standalone source status changed.

completeAnswer.selection: NEW for an ordinary cast select1–10 distinct willing perceived physical creature-origin recipients and one of the seven complete animal mappings per recipient before commitment. The common accepted Ready exception instead selects this set at release after paid preparation; fit is then checked before the release Reaction. No mass opt-in later, arbitrary bestiary, CR filtering, hidden target replacement or switching forms during the effect. Form names denote actual chosen spell-local beast anatomy, not a change of origin taxonomy. Object-origin transformed objects, summon bodies with incompatible lifecycle, unknown anatomy/mass and undocumented origin require their own established source; otherwise that dependent branch is held. Actual willing withdrawal before resolution makes only that recipient fail, with cost retained.
completeAnswer.duration: NEW one shared rank8 concentration record expires exactly60elapsedseconds after successful application; individual target links may end separately. Caster concentration loss/death ends all links; ending the final target link ends this now-empty shared concentration. Range120 is acquisition/application only, not a maintained tether. No extra body, turn, HP pool, concentration slot or form-switch Action is granted.
completeAnswer.geometry: NEW reuse accepted all-outcome fit: before ordinary payment (or before an already-paid Ready release Reaction) every target origin O and proposed transformed T must fit simultaneously for every pair O/O,O/T,T/O,T/T, other creatures, occupied matter and height. Reproject roots when this caster must drop an earlier concentration. Recheck at resolution; hidden newly blocked recipient fails, no displacement of another actor. Mandatory reversion ends the form even if placement becomes difficult: source-scoped BODY same anchor, actual legal squeeze, then nearest legal adjacent in the same unobstructed region, minimum displacement/greatest overlap/fixed neutral board tie; no farther search or barrier crossing. If none, record placementConflict and hold geometry-dependent continuation. Banishment-specific conflict rules are not globalized.
completeAnswer.identityAndGear: NEW explicitly reuse accepted creature transformation conservation. Scores, PB, HP/max/tempHP, class resources, Wounds, injuries, identity, species/ancestry, conditions and initiative remain real. Only listed anatomy/movement/AC/natural attack changes. Base body weight unchanged even across sizes; actual cargo still weighs including melded items; BODY carry/load and actual anatomy restrictions apply. Earliest root carried gear becomes melded, inaccessible, custody unchanged; incompatible armor/features cease expression. Existing external cargo stays external. Successful legal replacement closes previous anatomy atomically and recaptures actual extant gear once, never restores consumed items, charges or healing. No displaced form stack. Druid class Shapeshift cannot enter while a spell-form record remains, including suppressed.
completeAnswer.attacks: NEW use current original caster attack bonus/M for the mapped natural attack; original caster statistics must be actually resolvable. Subject is the attacker/damage owner for Null, kill credit and reactions; no caster cast-proc on a natural attack. One attack per ordinary Attack Action, reach5, listed dice+M; no Multiattack, spells, magic attacks, class beast benefits or senses beyond mapped/existing compatible source. Missing caster-stat provenance holds the attack branch; other links do not disappear.
completeAnswer.endings: Temporary form ends for that target on actual normalHP0, actual death or external Incapacitated after same-packet survival replacements. A real remain-at1 intervention prevents that zero ending. Each willing recipient may reject using one ordinary Action on its own regular turn if actually able, even while suppressed. New rank8 temporary anatomy may replace actual temporary ranks≤8 on success, not permanent True Polymorph absent its exact exception. A failed new cast leaves another caster’s prior form; same-caster concentration already ended is never restored.
completeAnswer.suppression: Suppression expresses earliest root anatomy while original melded gear remains inaccessible; it does not recapture gear, refund RP, end concentration, pause deadline or restore a displaced form. Unsuppression restores only a surviving unexpired link. Loss of actual flight begins accepted Falling now, first descent at END of the enclosing original regular slot NEXT round, then6second steps≤300ft. No instant ground teleport; actual landing damage min(10,floor(uncontrolledFeet/20))d6, positive damage causes Prone. Regaining adequate flight ends Falling without impact.

originalQuestionUnchanged.individualQuestion: Preserve GROWING A DUPLICATE OF A CREATURE AS INSURANCE AGAINST DEATH; Core Action/120ft/Instantaneous. Define eligible source creature,willingness,actual physical prerequisites,growth time,maturity,dormancy and finite clone count. Supply an explicit death-triggered replacement procedure with identity,HP,conditions,spent resources,equipment and subsequent body disposition using reviewed life/return rules. Distinguish a stored replacement body from an independently active duplicate character. Costs,vessel requirements or long growth periods are NEW if selected; do not silently import another game's Clone. Do not invent soul travel or cosmological machinery; any genuinely required such branch is deferred. Repeated clones cannot grant concurrent characters,duplicate inventory or reset permanent consequences automatically.

resolution: The complete proposed procedure, its explicit NEW choices and scoped source reuse answer this whole identity question. All printed benefits/native access retained; no standalone source status changed.

completeAnswer.eligibility: NEW one willing living physical creature-origin identity with a documented reproducible persistent root body. Perceive the source within120ft/LoE and designate a legal unoccupied growth envelope adjacent to it and also within120ft/LoE, same established plane. No printed vessel, blood sample, gem or extra price is added. Physical Constructs are not automatically excluded if actually living/reproducible by their own source; HP-only animations, transformed objects and temporary summoned bodies gain no Clone eligibility by appearance. Unknown reproduction/physiology holds the whole dependent branch. Validate the entire root body envelope, mass and missing parts, excluding temporary form anatomy and gear.
completeAnswer.growth: NEW the paid instantaneous cast produces one full-size inert immature physical duplicate at that anchor; it never acts, has no personal identity, inventory, class resources or companion slot. Maturity at createdAt+86400elapsedseconds, phase0 before a new death check at equality. No concentration; clock continues in antimagic. The magical rank8 insurance link persists until consumed, replaced, destroyed with the body, or actually ended by a source-qualified dispel. Caster death alone does not end it. Physical matter is not a maintained magical body and does not vanish in suppression.
completeAnswer.body: NEW dormant replacement body uses object-like structural AC10 and20structuralHP, no resistance, immunity, regeneration or separate personal HP pool. At structural0 it is destroyed and its entitlement ends. The intact viable-return gate requires structuralHP20 and no new anatomy/storage damage; partial damage blocks return until actual applicable repair restores structural20 and anatomy. Structural repair never heals the source character. Dormancy supplies only no metabolic air/food/water consumption while uninhabited, an explicit Clone-local completion; temperature, fire, pressure, decay, crushing and physical movement use actual applicable sources. No implicit safe vessel, preservation against environmental harm or free moving body. Repeated paid casts can leave multiple inert physical bodies; the finite cap is one live entitlement, not a world population limit. Missing hazard/storage content holds the affected branch. Detached matter or replaced bodies do not acquire autonomous life, XP, harvest awards or new spell fuel by this procedure.
completeAnswer.entitlement: NEW at most one live insurance entitlement per source identity across all casters. Only successful valid new establishment replaces the old link, not its physical body. Failed/blocked/countered attempt leaves the older link. Store unique entitlementId, bodyId, sourceIdentity, creator, body snapshot, timestamps, suppression, condition and attempted death IDs. Consumed/replaced bodies have no duplicate entitlement; their physical provenance remains.
completeAnswer.trigger: NEW actual completed death, after applicable would-die replacements and actual death triggers, opens one immediate optional return attempt. Earlier survival means no death ID and no Clone attempt. Require actual identity dead, actual willingness, mature/intact eligible unclaimed body, unsuppressed/unended link, legal destination and real return permissions. Another already successful return/claim wins; there can be only one living personal identity. Check identity-level barriers such as actual Soul Bind globally by their exact scope. Clone uses the stored body as its local return anchor: corpse-local Mass Resurrection Denial at the old corpse alone does not block a different stored anchor outside it; a matching actual barrier at the stored body does. Old corpse remains is not the paid return body. Cross-plane routing and unknown soul/topology facts are held, not granted by range120.
completeAnswer.claim: NEW resolve one atomic claim of the eligible body and identity, consume entitlement once, retire the dormant structuralHP pool (retain its historical damage record but it is no longer an active pool), then assign life1normalHP with present lawful maximum and protected lethal-track handling from the later healing/death closure. No HP-healing multiplier or living cannot-regain-HP effect converts this life assignment to healing or0HP. Actual life/identity barrier prevents claim before assignment. Record this death ID attempted even on decline/immaturity/suppression/occupation/barrier failure; no queued resurrection, delayed eligibility, repeat or replay. An intact unconsumed link may remain for a later genuinely distinct death after an actual intervening return, not continued retry of this death. Destroyed/replaced/ended links cannot.
completeAnswer.conservation: Return relocates the one personal identity into the actual clone body; physical old remains and their actual gear persist at their old positions but all other remains lose duplicate-return eligibility. No cloned gear, RP, spellbook, slots, daily uses, Wounds, injuries, exhaustion, debt or memory reset. Present personal scores/progression and HP ledger apply, not the creation snapshot. Concentration ended on death stays ended. Current personal injuries remain functional restrictions on the stored body; an older intact limb is not permission to cure a current missing-limb injury. Actual clone damage imposes its own restrictions too. Unsupported anatomy reconciliation is held; no mass/limb restoration is inferred. Protected Exhaustion6 returns alive and collapsed under later healing/death, not immediately re-killed by maximum recomputation.
completeAnswer.suppressionAndTermination: Actual antimagic suppresses only the magical link/attempt, not physical stored matter or maturation time. Ending suppression never replays old death. A source-qualified successful rank8 dispel ends the link permanently but leaves the body inert. Moving/damaging/storage acts require actual actors/actions/material predicates. No indestructible remote soul container or soul-sensing information is granted.

originalQuestionUnchanged.individualQuestion: Preserve a target with STRICTLY LESS THAN100HP making a CON SAVE OR DYING AND RISING AS UNDEAD; Core Action/120ft/Instantaneous. Bind threshold to actual currentHP versus temporary/formHP and define eligibility,save success and irreversible event order. State the resulting undead identity,complete profile,control,creation timing,duration and corpse/gear history. Compare Finger of Death and Create Undead without automatically choosing their strongest versions or assuming a Zombie profile. Resolve instant-death protections and resurrection interactions under native rules; no duplicate surviving original plus undead or fresh harvesting pool. Preserve the strict threshold and both death/rising clauses as separate authored consequences.

resolution: The complete proposed procedure, its explicit NEW choices and scoped source reuse answer this whole identity question. All printed benefits/native access retained; no standalone source status changed.

completeAnswer.eligibility: NEW one perceived living physical creature within120ft/LoE. Actual current normalHP must be strictly<100 at application; temporaryHP never enters the threshold. Living dying0 qualifies; already dead/nonliving HP-only animation does not. This is an explicit living target completion, not an inferred universal Necromancy immunity. Known impossible target rejects before pay; hidden100+, hidden nonliving identity or changed eligibility spends a lawful commitment without numeric disclosure, no retarget. Eligible target makes one binary CON save against actual caster DC; success prevents both death and rising.
completeAnswer.death: On failure and after actual applicable defenses, resolve a nondamage would-die event. No necrotic damage, damage root, Wound save, zero-HP damage threshold or death-save failure is fabricated. TemporaryHP, resistances, caster Null Veil damage nonlethality and ordinary Death Ward positive-to-zero floor do not themselves prevent this event. A real applicable would-die replacement (e.g. actually acquired Cleric16 Ritual of Undeath Ward, already paid and active) can prevent death; then no rising. Finish actual death and its sourced triggers/claims before attempting body allocation.
completeAnswer.rising: NEW physical Ghoul-derived animation, explicitly not a same-person undead resurrection. Only this spell’s actual completed death can supply its same usable body. If a prior actual death-trigger return such as Clone succeeds for this death, cancel this spell’s rising even if old remains still exist; do not create a simultaneous living original and newly animated old body from this event. Otherwise require connected usable actual body/anatomy and unclaimed matter. Missing/destroyed/disintegrated/already allocated body blocks rising without rewinding death or selecting another corpse. Unknown physical premises hold the rising branch. The local adaptation permits actual Tiny through Large creature bodies rather than importing Create Undead’s Small/Medium Humanoid gate; fixed stats do not guess a creature CR or restore missing parts.

completeAnswer.statisticsJustification: NEW choose only the accepted Ghoul comparison’s fixed40HP/13AC/six scores/movement/attack/rider, never the strongest four-profile result. Copy exact numbers into the new actor. Original person remains dead; memories, personality, classes, magical training, resources, ownership and soul are not transferred. completeAnswer.agency: NEW no automatic caster control, loyalty, hostility, work order, wages or companion command allowance. Independent actor has no turn in creation round; first independent opportunity is the next numbered round at a fixed virtual slot immediately after the original caster’s captured regular slot, then once each numbered round, regardless of creator initiative change/death. It receives ordinary Action/movement/Bonus Action/Reaction only when a source grants usable actions; no Extra Attack or special reaction. Actual goals/content/needs must be supplied before campaign use, otherwise the agency-dependent branch is held. Explicit fixture goal is test input, not granted by the spell.
completeAnswer.persistence: Physical conversion is permanent and survives original caster loss, ordinary antimagic and link dispel. Only the slow rider is magical/nonspell and suppressible; generic spell-only dispel does not erase the physical body or a nonspell rider. Completed0structuralHP destroys the HP-only animation and leaves consumed unusable-for-new-animation remains and real gear; no Wounds/death-save or ordinary living healing engine unless another exact source grants it. No new corpse, XP, resource, harvest or resurrection-target farm follows. Actual applicable physical damage/healing/repair/needs require sources; Undead does not imply no food/air/water/sleep.
completeAnswer.nullAndReturn: NEW explicitly extend the named animation NullDisabled rule: a qualifying damage-root Nonlethal effect on this HP-only animation leaves it inert at0, not destroyed; identity-specific disabling and recovery require the actual Null source. No generic nondamage prevention follows. Future attacks use the animation as damage owner; original caster Null is not inherited. Later true resurrection is governed by its exact identity/body requirements and current claims; no body can be allocated twice. This spell gives no new personal soul binding, compelled service, CR-based command access or cosmology.

originalQuestionUnchanged.individualQuestion: Preserve an ALLY gaining+4 TO ALL PHYSICAL STATS and IGNORING EXHAUSTION EFFECTS FOR1MINUTE; Core Action/120ft/Instantaneous. Define physical stats as specific native scores/modifiers,ability caps,derived attacks/AC/saves/carrying and CON-related maximum/currentHP changes. Resolve duration/concentration explicitly and compare Metaburst without silently substituting one-stat enhancement. Ignoring exhaustion effects must be distinguished from removing accumulated exhaustion,preventing new levels or waiving actual work/rest costs. On ending/suppression,restore lawful underlying values while retaining real damage and exhaustion history; recasts cannot manufacture healing or repeated recovery. Preserve all printed benefits with exact stacking rules.

resolution: The complete proposed procedure, its explicit NEW choices and scoped source reuse answer this whole identity question. All printed benefits/native access retained; no standalone source status changed.

completeAnswer.eligibilityAndDuration: NEW one actually allied living physical creature, including self, within120ft/LoE for60elapsedseconds, nonconcentration. Amend recommended P01’s added willingness requirement: the printed native card says Ally, not willing. No additional consent or save gate is imposed, so an actual unconscious ally can receive this benign benefit; this does not imply unconscious consent for another spell or force allegiance. Already dead target gains no revival. Core Instantaneous remains verbatim as a source conflict; printed minute governs the authored continuing effect.
completeAnswer.scores: NEW physical stats means STR,DEX,CON scores each+4, not+4 modifiers/rolls. Apply actual score-setting layers then this compatible bonus according to actual sources. Same-spell component bonus is at most+4 per ability, irrespective of multiple records; strongest same-name wins while every record keeps independent duration/suppression. No advancement20cap is silently imported; an actual explicit absolute cap retains its own scope. Floor((score−10)/2) is the resulting ordinary modifier. No changes to INT,WIS,CHA, proficiency, classes or armor permissions.
completeAnswer.capacity: NEW this spell specifically authorizes its temporary CON component to recompute attained-level baseHP: sum(max(1,stored level base result + current authorized HP-CON modifier)) across actual attained levels, including the actual first-level Hit Die maximum. Do not use level×2 when per-level floors bind. Other temporary CON sources do not receive this authorization. Combine actual independently authorized permanent/temporary HP-CON layers, then add compatible max bonuses, subtract strongest actual max trauma, floor subtotal to1, multiply exact systemic rational factors together and floor once/min1. Exhaustion4 factor1/2 is omitted only while mask active; expedition4+factor3/4 remains. Capacity rise gives no healing; decrease clamps normalHP only, no damage/Wound/fall/proc/death-save event; tempHP unchanged. Recompute ordinary STR melee attack/damage and checks, DEX attack/check/save and actual AC formula, CON saves/checks, and actual carrying/movement from current anatomy; do not substitute recipient modifiers for an Animal Shapes attack that explicitly uses its caster. Unarmored AC10+DEX changes by the actual modifier delta; worn armor caps and finite-form max(ordinary AC,profile AC) remain exact. BODY pounds capacity Tiny STR*7.5, Small/Medium STR*15, Large STR*30; Load Tiny STR/2, Small max(0,STR−2), Medium STR, Large2STR. No extra attack, proficiency or action arises.
completeAnswer.mask: NEW active Exhaustion component masks every effect of the actual six-level Exhaustion track, including half maximumHP, Speed0 and lethal6 endpoint. Retain levels, provenance, every unprevented gain and all costs/recovery prerequisites; this is not level-gain immunity. Only Exhaustion-derived disadvantage/Speed/max/collapse/Unconscious is removed; independent zeroHP unconsciousness, restraints, expedition/serum/Revelation strain and other source penalties remain. Never revive a creature already dead.
completeAnswer.lethalLifecycle: Store protectedStaticEndpoint from an actual earlier lawful death-prevention/return and a separate pendingFreshEndpoint. Gaining6 or a new positive unprevented gain while already6 during masking records a single pendingFreshEndpoint; no death resolves while masked. At last mask loss at6, if pendingFreshEndpoint or no protectedStaticEndpoint, open exactly one fresh would-die event and offer actual finite protection; if prevented, clear pending and install protected collapse at6. If protectedStaticEndpoint and no new gain, merely restore protected collapse alive/Unconscious, never re-kill through HP recomputation. An existing protected collapse may be temporarily masked at positiveHP, but independent Unconscious remains. Actual recovery below6 clears obsolete pending/protected endpoint, not an old past death. Overlapping active masks prevent premature endpoint evaluation. Simultaneous mask expiry is one effective transition, not several deaths.
completeAnswer.componentOrder: NEW each source has STR/DEX/CON and Exhaustion components separately active/suppressed/ended. At actual change: expire due records phase0; arbitrate active components; compute actual scores and authorized baseHP; apply present rational maximum factors; clamp normalHP; then process actual source-specific collapse/lethal transition. A maxHP helper itself never kills. Partial CON suppression may clamp without mask loss, and mask suppression may reinstate Exhaustion while scores stay+4. No prior attack/save replay, RP refund or deadline pause. Death ends this living-recipient effect; later return cannot restore it from a body snapshot.
completeAnswer.recovery: Ordinary qualifying8hour long rest can remove1Exhaustion only with actual food/water, inactive cause, legal care and once-per24hour gate; masking grants none of these. An unconscious protected collapsed creature may complete actual qualifying care/rest under later healing/death. A60second cast does not manufacture8hours or remove levels. Real work/travel gains remain, and mask loss is evaluated from present levels, not original levels.
completeAnswer.formInteraction: Same-identity transformations preserve real scores/HP ledger; this bonus applies only if target still living and actual compatible sources permit it, no second form HP pool or flesh repair. It never changes Beast/Undead taxonomy, gear compatibility, existing injury or the actual caster-stat owner of Animal Shapes attacks.
